scripts.setup: npm run setup:web && npm run setup:ai
scripts.setup:ai: python -m venv services/ai/.venv && node scripts/py.mjs -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:ai && npm run test:db
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:ai
scripts.lint:web: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.lint:ai: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check . && node scripts/py.mjs -m mypy
